## TL;DR

Pass 2 freeze doc corrections are in `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agent-workflow-rules.md`, and `docs/close-out-pipeline.md`. Handoff had failed on thinkpad during remote full-suite validation (`pm-canned-messages`); merged `main`, hardened that test’s “Answer in PM” flow for slow runners, formatted, and scoped `repoos check --changed main` passed.

## Work and rationale

The three freeze doc items match implementation: handoff **fails at the commit step** with named paths when heal throws; merge-base siblings are **restored** and post-merge main-only bookkeeping is **dropped** (main’s copy wins); **sync** heals after successful or aborted merges. The remote failure was unrelated to #1086 bookkeeping code — the branch had drifted behind `main`, and the PM drawer test could race on a slow host before the PM tab painted `.pm-open-questions`.

## Approaches tried

Doc-only pass first; after remote check failure, merged `main` (task file conflict → main’s copy) and aligned the flaky test with `task-needs-input-status` (find “Answer in PM”, poll until open-questions mount).

## Challenges and blockers

Read-only worktree paths needed `chmod u+w`. Remote handoff runs the **full** suite on thinkpad, not `--changed main`.

## Key learnings

A scoped green self-check does not imply remote handoff pass when validation runs the full suite on a runner.

## Suggestions (not blocking per freeze)

Restore-before-report commit ordering; explicit server.ts sync test (already present in branch); `repoos.toml` filter; `request-close-out` changedPaths.
